Pumpkaboo

Ghost Grass

Kalos · Generation 6

Pumpkaboo is a Ghost/Grass-type Pumpkin Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 5 kg. It evolves into Gourgeist. Its highest base stat is Defense (70), with a base stat total of 335.
